How · Questions

Invoices that chase themselves.

Send it once. Reminders go out on your schedule, signed by you, and the tax is put aside the minute it is paid.

How it gets paid

  1. Draft it from a quote.

    Start from the quote you already sent, or from the hours on your timer.

  2. Send it in a tap.

    It goes out as a link and a PDF, with your logo and your terms.

  3. The reminder goes for you.

    Three days before it is due, a friendly note in your words.

  4. The tax goes aside.

    The moment it is paid, a slice moves to your tax pot.

Made for people who work for themselves.

Questions before you start.

Will the reminders annoy my clients?

They are short and polite, and you choose when they go.

Is it really free?

Up to ten invoices a month.

Can I bring my old invoices?

Yes, from a spreadsheet.

What about VAT?

Add it per line or per invoice.

Where is my money held?

With a regulated partner bank.

Can I stop any time?

Yes, and you keep every invoice.

Does it work on a phone?

It was made there first.

Who reads my data?

Nobody but you.
